notes:
Customer profile: B2B SaaS startup (In-app chat assistant for product support and workflow automation). Fast-moving product team; founders ex-Slack. Primary ask: sub-150ms p95 token latency for streaming UX, consistent streaming chunks, must support 30 sustained RPS with burst to ~100 RPS. Current infra: standard AWS us-east-1; plan to stay public cloud hosted.

Technical details / requirements:
- Workload: user-facing conversational UI + short summaries of threads. Heavy context windows per session (~1-2K tokens), but many requests are short follow-ups.
- Preferred models: open/compatible low-latency endpoints (customer mentioned trying a 13B optimized variant). Interested in guidance on quantization vs managed low-latency variants.
- Streaming: critical. UX requires progressive tokens every 50-100ms chunks, ability to cancel mid-stream.
- Throughput & cost: cost-sensitive early-stage — target ~10-20k tokens/day initially; want predictable per-token pricing and transparent quota management.
- Security/compliance: want SSO for admin console (SAML), audit logs for token usage, and retention controls for message history; some EU customers — asking about data residency options but will accept US-hosted for MVP.

POC success criteria (agreed):
- p95 token latency <= 150ms for typical prompts in us-east-1 under 30 RPS load (streaming on),
- graceful fallback to smaller model under heavy load w/out UI error states,
- integration of prefix caching reduces token volume by >=15% for repeat help queries,
- telemetry hooks (traces + per-route token cost) visible in Console during POC.

Quotes / call snippets:
- "We need the chat to feel instantaneous — streaming is a hard requirement." — Head of Product
- "If we can't get stable low p95 latency, the UX degrades and adoption stalls." — Eng lead

Notes on engagement / tone: very pragmatic, biased to self-serve; came in from product-led signup. Wants lightweight docs and a quick POC rather than long enterprise sales. Potential to expand to Dedicated in 12-18 months as volume and compliance needs increase.

Suggested SE playbook:
- Send step-by-step hosted API streaming quickstart (include sample websocket/response-chunk handler).
- Provide sample latency test harness (k6 + small client) and perf baseline for model variants we recommend.
- Attach cost projection spreadsheet (drive link) and short checklist for enabling prefix caching.

Open questions to resolve:
- exact token retention policy for EU users if they need residency,
- whether they will require org-level SSO for admin before paid conversion.
